primary_text.paraphrase: Smith2017 section4a describes irregular ribbed sac casts, sandstone infill, and a suture branching at a thicker end.

primary_text.paraphrase: Ivantsov2016 describes elliptical basal anchors with tubular walls meeting at a basal zigzag. Their longer horizontal axis parallels that join. Classic upright fossils are incomplete; specimen form can be flexed or folded. Trunk and fans remain excluded.

concept.observations: Genuine original concept personally viewed. Retain incomplete hollow sack; preserve original freeze correction away from round vase. Concept wraparound belt-like zigzag is not adopted literally: source-informed join must follow the basal long axis.
